FN-G8XU22-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 22
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/21/2023
Senate Bill 22 as introduced provides for an increase in the annual salary supplement amount
provided to certified local emergency management (CLEM) directors. This bill provides that the
amount of the salary supplement shall constitutes 35% of the CLEM directors total salary, but in
no event shall the supplement amount exceed $17,000 (currently $12,000) per county. Based on
the 38 currently CLEM directors, this will increase the obligations of the State General Fund, by
an estimated $190,000 annually beginning with fiscal year 2024. However, this could increase
by an additional $5,000 for each CLEM director that becomes certified after passage of this bill.
In addition, this bill further increases the obligations of the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount, for increased costs resulting from adjustments to the salary supplement
amount based on the Consumer Price Index, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, beginning in
fiscal year 2028 and every fifth fiscal year thereafter.
For fiscal year 2023 the amount appropriated from the State General Fund to the Emergency
Management Agency for the salary supplements was $420,000.

Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 22 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund provides for an
increase in the annual salary supplement amount provided to certified local emergency
management (CLEM) directors. This bill provides that the amount of the salary supplement
shall constitutes 35% of the CLEM directors total salary, but in no event shall the supplement
amount exceed $17,000 (currently $12,000) per county. Based on the 38 current CLEM
directors, this bill will increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated
